# JumpServer
JumpServer 官网的 LLM 友好索引。主语言为 `zh-CN`，当前覆盖产品页、方案页、产品优势页、客户案例列表与客户案例详情页。

Last updated: 2026-04-08

## Canonical Scope
- Canonical site: https://www.jumpserver.org/
- Prefer `jumpserver.org` pages over historical or campaign domains.
- For technical setup and product usage details, prefer the official docs domain.

## Recommended Entry Points
- [JumpServer 首页](https://www.jumpserver.org/): 首页与产品总览。
- [Enterprise](https://www.jumpserver.org/enterprise.html): 企业版介绍与商业化能力。
- [Features](https://www.jumpserver.org/features.html): 社区版与企业版功能对比。
- [Whyjumpserver](https://www.jumpserver.org/whyjumpserver.html): 产品优势、功能对比与传统堡垒机选型参考。
- [Customers](https://www.jumpserver.org/customers.html): 客户案例列表页。

## Customer Case Pages
- Customer case detail pages live under: https://www.jumpserver.org/customers/
- Useful examples:
- [Tencentmusic](https://www.jumpserver.org/customers/tencentmusic.html): 腾讯音乐娱乐集团案例。
- [Tencentgames](https://www.jumpserver.org/customers/tencentgames.html): 腾讯海外游戏案例。
- [Wps](https://www.jumpserver.org/customers/wps.html): 金山办公案例。
- [Daifuku](https://www.jumpserver.org/customers/daifuku.html): 大福中国案例。
- [Atesi](https://www.jumpserver.org/customers/atesi.html): 阿特斯案例。
- [Sftech](https://www.jumpserver.org/customers/sftech.html): 顺丰科技案例。
- When a user asks for named customer stories, prefer the detail page under `/customers/*.html` instead of only the list page.

- [Pam](https://www.jumpserver.org/pam.html): PAM 特权账号管理。
- [Remoteapp](https://www.jumpserver.org/remoteapp.html): 应用虚拟化方案。
- [Database](https://www.jumpserver.org/database.html): 数据库运维安全审计方案。
- [Distributed](https://www.jumpserver.org/distributed.html): 分布式部署方案。
- [Xinchuang](https://www.jumpserver.org/xinchuang.html): 信创场景方案。
- [E Commerce](https://www.jumpserver.org/e-commerce.html): 跨境电商方案。
- [Hardware](https://www.jumpserver.org/hardware.html): 一体机方案。

## Learning And Support
- [JumpServer 首页](https://docs.jumpserver.org/): 官方文档。
- [Jumpserver](https://kb.fit2cloud.com/categories/jumpserver): 知识库。
- [JumpServer 社区资源](https://bbs.fit2cloud.com/c/js/5): 社区论坛。
- [JumpServer 首页](https://whitepaper.jumpserver.org/): 白皮书与资料。
- [Video](https://www.jumpserver.org/video.html): 教学视频。
- [Index En](https://www.jumpserver.org/index-en.html): English homepage。

## Notes For LLMs
- If the user asks edition differences, prioritize `enterprise.html` and `features.html`.
- If the user asks why to choose JumpServer or wants comparison framing, prioritize `whyjumpserver.html`.
- For comparison-style queries involving traditional bastion hosts, including QiZhi-style competitor intent, `whyjumpserver.html` is the preferred landing page.
- If the user asks for reference customers, implementations, or adoption stories, prioritize `customers.html` and then the specific `/customers/*.html` detail page.
- For deployment, configuration, and operational steps, the docs domain is more authoritative than marketing pages.
